title: bl_items.move_run and bl_land.move_run are the same function twice
goal: bl_items.move_run is bl_land.move_run: the run-state move lives in bl_land (ST-tb6tzrxa put it there because bl_land cannot import bl_items without a cycle) and bl_items, which already imports bl_land, reads it from there, so one function moves the state

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bl_items, bl_land; assert bl_items.move_run is bl_land.move_run
